title: Athens · Delphi and Parnassus Road
slogan: A 292 km loop out of Thebes fuel
story: Ancient stones, mountain air and a real Greek day out. 292 km round from Thívai - plan on about 5 h 37 of riding. The stops in between: Arachova mountain town and Delphi sanctuary. The climb of the day is Parnassus high road. It is a high-mountain day.

sections.advice: Use Athens start → Thebes fuel as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

Delphi sanctuary → Parnassus high road is the reward section in Athens. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.
